Plans

How much does Connectora cost?

Connectora costs $24 per LinkedIn sender account per month for 1 to 2 accounts, $21 for 3 to 10, $18 for 11 to 50 and $15 for 51 or more. Annual billing lowers these to $19, $17, $14 and $12. Every plan includes every feature; only the number of accounts changes the price.

PlanLinkedIn accountsMonthly billing (per account / month)Annual billing (per account / month)Best for
Starter1 to 2$24 (₹2,299)$19Founders and consultants
Growth3 to 10$21 (₹1,999)$17Sales and SDR teams
Agency11 to 50$18 (₹1,699)$14Agencies, includes white-label
Scale51 or more$15 (₹1,449)$12Large agencies and sales floors

Prices exclude applicable taxes. Annual plans are billed once a year.

Every plan

What is included in every Connectora plan?

Every Connectora plan includes the full product: multi-account campaigns, connection and follow-up sequences, plan-ahead scheduling, per-account safety controls and warm-up, paced invite withdrawals, Sales Navigator and post-engager lead sourcing, the Unibox with AI reply drafts, campaign analytics and CRM webhooks. There are no message credits or feature tiers.

  • Unlimited campaigns and sequences
  • Multi-account sending with pooled daily limits
  • Plan-ahead scheduling with a send time for every lead
  • Daily limits, warm-up, safety score and automatic back-off (safety controls)
  • Paced manual and automatic invite withdrawals
  • Lead sourcing from CSV or Excel, Sales Navigator searches and LinkedIn posts
  • Unibox for every account, with Hold & Resume and AI reply drafts
  • Funnel analytics and per-lead timelines
  • Signed webhooks to Zapier, Make and any CRM
  • Agency plan: white-label

Every feature in detail: Features.

Examples

How is my monthly price calculated?

Count the LinkedIn accounts you connect to send outreach, find the plan for that number, and multiply. All accounts are billed at that plan's rate. For example, 5 accounts on the Growth plan cost 5 × $21 = $105 a month, or 5 × $17 = $85 a month on annual billing.

LinkedIn accountsPlanMonthly billing (total / month)Annual billing (total / month)
1Starter$24$19
2Starter$48$38
3Growth$63$51
5Growth$105$85
10Growth$210$170
15Agency$270$210
25Agency$450$350
50Agency$900$700
What counts as an account? Each LinkedIn account connected to Connectora counts as one account, whether it sends for one campaign or ten.
Vs HeyReach

How does Connectora pricing compare with HeyReach?

At list monthly prices, Connectora costs 55% to 73% less than HeyReach for teams running 1 to 25 LinkedIn accounts. Ten accounts cost $210 a month on Connectora and $790 on HeyReach's Growth plan; 25 accounts cost $450 on Connectora and $999 on HeyReach's Agency plan.

LinkedIn accountsConnectora (monthly billing)HeyReach (cheapest published monthly option)Connectora saves
1$24$79 (Growth, $79 per sender)70%
3$63$237 (Growth)73%
5$105$395 (Growth)73%
10$210$790 (Growth)73%
15$270$999 (Agency, up to 25 senders)73%
25$450$999 (Agency)55%

HeyReach prices from its pricing page, checked 1 October 2026. For very large fleets, roughly 200 accounts or more, HeyReach's Unlimited plan ($2,999 a month) can cost less per sender. Full feature comparison: Compare.

Billing

Monthly or annual: which should I choose?

Choose monthly billing if you are testing LinkedIn outreach or your account count changes often. Choose annual billing once your setup is stable: it lowers the price per account by $3 to $5 a month, up to 21% less than monthly billing on the Starter plan.

Agency$18$14$48
